articles.title: Italian base in Iraqi Kurdistan hit by missile, defence ministry says
articles.summary: An Italian military base in Iraqi Kurdistan was struck by a missile overnight. The Italian defence ministry confirmed the incident, reporting no injuries. This event highlights the persistent security challenges faced by international forces stationed in the volatile region, demanding continuous vigilance from military personnel operating abroad.

articles.title: Ai+ Smartphone, Optiemus Electronics ink pact to manufacture 3 mn devices with Rs 125 cr investment
articles.summary: Homegrown tech brand Ai+ Smartphone has partnered with Optiemus Electronics Ltd to manufacture 3 million mobile devices in India. This collaboration, involving a joint investment, strengthens domestic electronics manufacturing and aligns with the 'Make in India' initiative. It signifies a boost for the nation's technology sector, fostering self-reliance in smartphone production and creating opportunities.

articles.title: SC grants bail to Kashmiri separatist leader Shabir Ahmed Shah in terror funding case
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has granted bail to Kashmiri separatist leader Shabir Ahmed Shah. Shah was arrested by the National Investigation Agency (NIA) on June 4 in a terror funding case. This decision from the apex court is significant in a high-profile case involving alleged funding of terror activities, highlighting legal processes related to national security and internal security challenges.
